scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立來源欄位到目標欄位的對照，標明原值、映射值、未知原因與schema版本，不將未知結果映成成功。
knowledge.textEn: Map source to destination fields with original value, mapped value, unknown reason and schema version; never map unknown outcomes to success.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學語意完整度以已知且正確映射的欄位槽位計算，並非OCSF官方分數或schema合法率。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching semantic completeness counts known correctly mapped slots; it is neither an official OCSF score nor schema validity.

stages.title: 來源語意盤點
stages.description: OCSF提供共通資安事件詞彙；本課比較能通過JSON解析與真正保留來源語意的差別。 建立來源欄位到目標欄位的對照，標明原值、映射值、未知原因與schema版本，不將未知結果映成成功。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 用100個event_id乘五個指定教學欄位建立500格矩陣，每格有value、known與mapping_reason。保留unknown與not_applicable的不同標記，本課兩者分母規則必先寫明；不能以任意字串填入unknown格就提高語意分數。
stages.descriptionEn: OCSF provides shared security-event vocabulary; distinguish parseable JSON from preservation of source semantics. Map source to destination fields with original value, mapped value, unknown reason and schema version; never map unknown outcomes to success. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Construct a 500-cell matrix from 100 event IDs and five explicitly selected teaching fields. Every cell has value, known and mapping_reason. Distinguish unknown from not_applicable and state the denominator rule before scoring either. Filling an unknown cell with an arbitrary string must not improve the semantic score merely because the output now contains text.
